codeReview.summary: The fix commit adequately addresses both prior failing reviews. Init now performs real port-in-use checks with deterministic alternate selection, init summary now includes total estimated memory, and models active/remote detection is now source+quant-aware instead of model-id-only matching.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Workers are repeatedly unable to invoke the required `cli-feature` skill at runtime even though the skill file exists in the repository, creating procedure drift from feature metadata expectations.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Fix transcript skeleton includes `Error: Skill "cli-feature" not found`; handoff `skillFeedback.deviations` says the worker proceeded without the skill. The same mismatch appears in prior init/models handoffs and reviews.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The recommendation/init memory-budget behavior (models filtered individually by budget, while total selected tier memory may exceed budget) is not clearly captured in shared guidance, which caused test expectation churn during this fix.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Fix transcript skeleton notes a failed expectation and correction: "total memory ... exceeds the budget ... expected behavior — models are individually budget-eligible." This nuance is not explicit in mission AGENTS.md or .factory/library files.
